datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Lesotho administrative units. The spatial data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity phases for October-December 2020, with classifications standardized using the IPC scale and organized by scenario and collection date.
